name: Numeric X and North use world coordinates and grid snap through a rotated parent
Numeric rotation snaps the absolute world angle rather than the child local angle
Moving and rotating an Experience preserve member offsets and do not ground-snap the group
The source F1 circuit and descendants reject 3D scaling while unrelated child props remain editable
Already selected objects cannot mutate after their layer or ancestor becomes locked
Path, road, terrain and bridge settings survive control reconstruction and persist in world metadata
Invalid or empty tool numbers restore the prior value and finite values respect input limits
Hidden library selections are rejected and nonfinite numeric transforms cannot alter the scene
